data.narrative:
Ramon.Space is a Series B space and aerospace company that has raised $43.5M to date. Valuation analysis relies on two applicable triangulation methods drawn from a peer set of 5 private companies at Series B/C stages (Sierra Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Varda Space Industries, Aalyria, and Skyryse) and 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL).

The stage-progression method applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier to the $43.5M raised proxy, yielding $83M. The peer-median method anchors to the $1.5B median valuation across the five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private peers, with a range of $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring was not applicable due to absence of target revenue disclosure. These two methods produce a triangulated range of $70M (low) to $1.7B (high), with a median of $791M. The stage-progression result sits substantially below peer-median pricing, reflecting both the early-stage capital raised and the wide dispersion in peer valuations. Key uncertainties include the company's near-term revenue trajectory, customer concentration risk in the space sector, and whether recent peer valuations reflect durable market fundamentals or cyclical froth.
